summary: Spire Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a $400 million delayed draw senior unsecured term loan facility with Mizuho Bank as administrative agent and several other banks. The facility matures 364 days after effectiveness, allows up to four borrowings through December 31, 2026, and bears interest at base rate or Adjusted Term SOFR plus 0.80%. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; covenants include a consolidated capitalization ratio cap of 70%. This is a routine credit agreement, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply.
